info.name: Paxos Account Members Rewards Statements API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of statements to return. Defaults to 12 if not set.

params.name: page_cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

params.name: asset_type
params.description: When set, only statements for this asset type are returned.

params.name: type
params.description:
When set, only statements of this content type are returned.

 - STATEMENT_TYPE_MONTHLY_REWARDS: Monthly statement: PDF rewards summary with daily balance totals, rates, and
per-payout-group breakdown, plus a CSV per-wallet daily balance export.

items.docs:
Returns monthly rewards statements for the authenticated partner, ordered by
period newest first. Summary fields (total_accrued, avg_daily_balance) are
included in list responses. Presigned download URLs are populated on files
for completed statements only.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the statement to retrieve.

items.docs:
Returns a single rewards statement with presigned download URLs for each
generated file (PDF, CSV).
